The fire really brought out its sweetness.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Endura Carrots are a type of [[Roasted Food]], being the result of [[Endura Carrot]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Roasted Endura Carrots are sweet and considered to be an extravagant dish. [[Link]] can heal four [[Heart]]s by eating a Roasted Endura Carrot. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Endura Carrots reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Endura Carrot]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Roasted Endura Carrots are sweet and considered to be an extravagant dish. [[Link]] can heal three [[Heart]]s by eating a Roasted Endura Carrot. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Endura Carrot * Food * Roasted Food * Roasted Swift Carrot }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Carrots, Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
